author: David Bombal
description:
What is an AI data foundation, and why does it matter? We discuss how enterprise data gives AI context about your organization and workflows, explore local AI and Splunk deployment options, and explain how trusted data sources, data preparation, guardrails, and checking outputs help improve AI reliability.

Thank you to Cisco for sponsoring my trip to Splunk .conf26!
Time to learn more about Splunk! 

#SplunkConf26 #Splunk #Cisco
title: What Is an AI Data Foundation?
